part2.question: Describe a party that was held after a special event

segments.v: I want to talk about a party after my cousin's graduation. My cousin Trang graduated from university last summer. She is the first grandchild in my family to finish university. After the graduation ceremony, my family had a party at my uncle's restaurant. About thirty people came, including my relatives and her friends. The restaurant was decorated with balloons and a banner. We ate a lot of delicious food. My uncle made a speech and we sang karaoke. I took photos with my film camera. I remember this party because my grandfather made a very touching speech. He said he left school when he was twelve. Everyone was quiet and my grandmother cried. I felt very moved and I wanted to study harder.
